items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he played with Oren and Oliver.

ctx.x: Now, who did Bolton play with? Did he say he played even with Oliver and then? Yeah, he played with Oren and Oliver. Thank you.
Yeah, he played with Oren and Oliver.
I'll take seven up a drink. Unless somebody else wants to. Is that your favorite drink, Paul? The water. Oh, no. How much you want to miss it?
